reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2738 b, book 49, بَاب أَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ الْفُقَرَاءُ وَأَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ النِّسَاءُ وَبَيَانِ الْفِتْنَةِ بِالنِّسَاءِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُطَرِّفًا، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ كَانَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَتَانِ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ ‏.‏
en_text: And Muhammad ibn al-Walid ibn 'Abd al-Hamid narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Abu al-Tayyah, who said: I heard Mutarrif narrating that he had two wives, with the meaning of the hadith of Mu'adh.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2739, book 49, بَاب أَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ الْفُقَرَاءُ وَأَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ النِّسَاءُ وَبَيَانِ الْفِتْنَةِ بِالنِّسَاءِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ أَبُو زُرْعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ، عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ مِنْ دُعَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Ubaydullah ibn 'Abd al-Karim Abu Zur'ah narrated to us: Ibn Bukayr narrated to us: Ya'qub ibn 'Abd al-Rahman narrated to me, from Musa ibn 'Uqbah, from 'Abdullah ibn Dinar, from 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar, who said: Among the supplications of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was: "O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the withdrawal of Your blessing, the transformation of Your [grant of] well-being, the suddenness of Your retribution, and all of Your wrath."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2740, book 49, بَاب أَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ الْفُقَرَاءُ وَأَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ النِّسَاءُ وَبَيَانِ الْفِتْنَةِ بِالنِّسَاءِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، وَمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِي فِتْنَةً هِيَ أَضَرُّ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Sa'id ibn Mansur narrated to us: Sufyan and Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman narrated to us, from Sulayman al-Taymi, from Abu 'Uthman al-Nahdi, from Usamah ibn Zayd, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "I have not left behind me any tribulation that is more harmful to men than women."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2741 a, book 49, بَاب أَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ الْفُقَرَاءُ وَأَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ النِّسَاءُ وَبَيَانِ الْفِتْنَةِ بِالنِّسَاءِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، وَسُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الْمُعْتَمِرِ، قَالَ ابْنُ مُعَاذٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبِي حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ، أَنَّهُمَا حَدَّثَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِي فِي النَّاسِ فِتْنَةً أَضَرَّ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh al-'Anbari, Suwayd ibn Sa'id, and Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-A'la all narrated to us from al-Mu'tamir; Ibn Mu'adh said: Al-Mu'tamir ibn Sulayman narrated to us, saying: My father said: Abu 'Uthman narrated to us, from Usamah ibn Zayd ibn Harithah and Sa'id ibn Zayd ibn 'Amr ibn Nufayl, that they both narrated from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), that he said: "I have not left behind me among the people any tribulation more harmful to men than women."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2741 b, book 49, بَاب أَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ الْفُقَرَاءُ وَأَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ النِّسَاءُ وَبَيَانِ الْفِتْنَةِ بِالنِّسَاءِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Ibn Numayr both narrated to us: Abu Khalid al-Ahmar narrated to us; (H) and Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us: Hushaym informed us; (H) and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: Jarir informed us; all of them from Sulayman al-Taymi, with this chain of transmission, the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2742, book 49, بَاب أَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ الْفُقَرَاءُ وَأَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ النِّسَاءُ وَبَيَانِ الْفِتْنَةِ بِالنِّسَاءِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا نَضْرَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الدُّنْيَا حُلْوَةٌ خَضِرَةٌ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ مُسْتَخْلِفُكُمْ فِيهَا فَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ فَاتَّقُوا الدُّنْيَا وَاتَّقُوا النِّسَاءَ فَإِنَّ أَوَّلَ فِتْنَةِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ كَانَتْ فِي النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ بَشَّارٍ ‏"‏ لِيَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Muhammad ibn Bashshar both narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Abu Maslamah, who said: I heard Aba Nadrah narrating from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), who said: "Indeed, the world is sweet and green, and indeed Allah has appointed you as successors in it to see how you will act. So beware of the world and beware of women, for the first tribulation of the Children of Israel was in women." And in the hadith of Ibn Bashshar: "so that He may see how you will act."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2743 a, book 49, باب قِصَّةِ أَصْحَابِ الْغَارِ الثَّلاَثَةِ وَالتَّوَسُّلِ بِصَالِحِ الأَعْمَالِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْمُسَيَّبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عِيَاضٍ أَبَا ضَمْرَةَ - عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَمَا ثَلاَثَةُ نَفَرٍ يَتَمَشَّوْنَ أَخَذَهُمُ الْمَطَرُ فَأَوَوْا إِلَى غَارٍ فِي جَبَلٍ فَانْحَطَّتْ عَلَى فَمِ غَارِهِمْ صَخْرَةٌ مِنَ الْجَبَلِ فَانْطَبَقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ انْظُرُوا أَعْمَالاً عَمِلْتُمُوهَا صَالِحَةً لِلَّهِ فَادْعُوا اللَّهَ تَعَالَى بِهَا لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يَفْرُجُهَا عَنْكُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِي وَالِدَانِ شَيْخَانِ كَبِيرَانِ وَامْرَأَتِي وَلِيَ صِبْيَةٌ صِغَارٌ أَرْعَى عَلَيْهِمْ فَإِذَا أَرَحْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَلَبْتُ فَبَدَأْتُ بِوَالِدَىَّ فَسَقَيْتُهُمَا قَبْلَ بَنِيَّ وَأَنَّهُ نَأَى بِي ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ الشَّجَرُ فَلَمْ آتِ حَتَّى أَمْسَيْتُ فَوَجَدْتُهُمَا قَدْ نَامَا فَحَلَبْتُ كَمَا كُنْتُ أَحْلُبُ فَجِئْتُ بِالْحِلاَبِ فَقُمْتُ عِنْدَ رُءُوسِهِمَا أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُوقِظَهُمَا مِنْ نَوْمِهِمَا وَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَسْقِيَ الصِّبْيَةَ قَبْلَهُمَا وَالصِّبْيَةُ يَتَضَاغَوْنَ عِنْدَ قَدَمَىَّ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ ذَلِكَ دَأْبِي وَدَأْبَهُمْ حَتَّى طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مِنْهَا فُرْجَةً نَرَى مِنْهَا السَّمَاءَ ‏.‏ فَفَرَجَ اللَّهُ مِنْهَا فُرْجَةً فَرَأَوْا مِنْهَا السَّمَاءَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَتْ لِيَ ابْنَةُ عَمٍّ أَحْبَبْتُهَا كَأَشَدِّ مَا يُحِبُّ الرِّجَالُ النِّسَاءَ وَطَلَبْتُ إِلَيْهَا نَفْسَهَا فَأَبَتْ حَتَّى آتِيَهَا بِمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ فَتَعِبْتُ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مِائَةَ دِينَارٍ فَجِئْتُهَا بِهَا فَلَمَّا وَقَعْتُ بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهَا قَالَتْ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَفْتَحِ الْخَاتَمَ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّهِ ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ عَنْهَا فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مِنْهَا فُرْجَةً ‏.‏ فَفَرَجَ لَهُمْ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي كُنْتُ اسْتَأْجَرْتُ أَجِيرًا بِفَرَقِ أَرُزٍّ فَلَمَّا قَضَى عَمَلَهُ قَالَ أَعْطِنِي حَقِّي ‏.‏ فَعَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَرَقَهُ فَرَغِبَ عَنْهُ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أَزْرَعُهُ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مِنْهُ بَقَرًا وَرِعَاءَهَا فَجَاءَنِي فَقَالَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَظْلِمْنِي حَقِّي ‏.‏ قُلْتُ اذْهَبْ إِلَى تِلْكَ الْبَقَرِ وَرِعَائِهَا فَخُذْهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَسْتَهْزِئْ بِي ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي لاَ أَسْتَهْزِئُ بِكَ خُذْ ذَلِكَ الْبَقَرَ وَرِعَاءَهَا ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَهُ فَذَهَبَ بِهِ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مَا بَقِيَ ‏.‏ فَفَرَجَ اللَّهُ مَا بَقِيَ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Ishaq al-Musayyabi narrated to me: Anas—meaning Ibn 'Iyad Abu Damrah—narrated to me, from Musa ibn 'Uqbah, from Nafi', from 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar, from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), that he said: "While three persons were walking, rain overtook them, so they took shelter in a cave in a mountain. Then a rock fell from the mountain over the mouth of their cave, shutting them in. Some of them said to others: 'Look to righteous deeds you performed for Allah and supplicate Allah, Exalted is He, by them, so that perhaps Allah will relieve you from it.' One of them said: 'O Allah, I had two aged parents, a wife, and young children for whom I used to shepherd [flocks]. When I brought them back to rest in the evening, I milked [the herd] and began with my parents, giving them milk to drink before my children. One day the search for pasture took me far away, so I did not return until evening and found them both asleep. I milked as I used to milk and brought the milking vessel, standing by their heads; I disliked waking them from their sleep, and I disliked giving milk to the children before them, while the children were crying at my feet. That remained my condition and theirs until dawn broke. If You know that I did that seeking Your Countenance, then open for us an opening through which we may see the sky.' So Allah opened an opening for them through which they saw the sky. Another said: 'O Allah, I had a female cousin whom I loved as passionately as men love women. I sought her intimate favors, but she refused unless I brought her one hundred dinars. I toiled until I gathered one hundred dinars and brought them to her. When I sat between her legs, she said: "O servant of Allah, fear Allah, and do not break the seal except lawfully." So I stood up from her. If You know that I did that seeking Your Countenance, then open for us an opening.' So He opened [it further] for them. And the other said: 'O Allah, I had hired a laborer for a faraq of rice. When he finished his work, he said: "Give me my due." I offered him his faraq, but he turned away from it. I kept cultivating it until I amassed from it cattle and their herdsmen. Then he came to me and said: "Fear Allah, and do not wrong me of my due." I said: "Go to those cattle and their herdsmen and take them." He said: "Fear Allah and do not mock me." I said: "I am not mocking you; take those cattle and their herdsmen." So he took them and went away with them. If You know that I did that seeking Your Countenance, then open for us what remains.' So Allah opened what remained."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2743 b, book 49, باب قِصَّةِ أَصْحَابِ الْغَارِ الثَّلاَثَةِ وَالتَّوَسُّلِ بِصَالِحِ الأَعْمَالِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَرِيفٍ الْبَجَلِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَرَقَبَةُ بْنُ مَسْقَلَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي ضَمْرَةَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ وَزَادُوا فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏"‏ وَخَرَجُوا يَمْشُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ صَالِحٍ ‏"‏ يَتَمَاشَوْنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ وَخَرَجُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ بَعْدَهَا شَيْئًا ‏.‏
en_text: And Ishaq ibn Mansur and 'Abd ibn Humayd both narrated to us: Abu 'Asim informed us, from Ibn Jurayj: Musa ibn 'Uqbah informed me; (H) and Suwayd ibn Sa'id narrated to me: 'Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us, from 'Ubaydullah; (H) and Abu Kurayb and Muhammad ibn Tarif al-Bajali both narrated to me: Ibn Fudayl narrated to us: My father and Raqabah ibn Masqalah narrated to us; (H) and Zuhayr ibn Harb, Hasan al-Hulwani, and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me, saying: Ya'qub—meaning Ibn Ibrahim ibn Sa'd—narrated to us: My father narrated to us, from Salih ibn Kaysan; all of them from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) with the meaning of the hadith of Abu Damrah from Musa ibn 'Uqbah. And they added in their hadith: "and they exited walking." And in the hadith of Salih: "walking together." Except 'Ubaydullah, for in his hadith it is: "and they exited," and he mentioned nothing after it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2743 c, book 49, باب قِصَّةِ أَصْحَابِ الْغَارِ الثَّلاَثَةِ وَالتَّوَسُّلِ بِصَالِحِ الأَعْمَالِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بَهْرَامَ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ ابْنُ سَهْلٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ انْطَلَقَ ثَلاَثَةُ رَهْطٍ مِمَّنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ حَتَّى آوَاهُمُ الْمَبِيتُ إِلَى غَارٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ كَانَ لِي أَبَوَانِ شَيْخَانِ كَبِيرَانِ فَكُنْتُ لاَ أَغْبُقُ قَبْلَهُمَا أَهْلاً وَلاَ مَالاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ فَامْتَنَعَتْ مِنِّي حَتَّى أَلَمَّتْ بِهَا سَنَةٌ مِنَ السِّنِينَ فَجَاءَتْنِي فَأَعْطَيْتُهَا عِشْرِينَ وَمِائَةَ دِينَارٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ فَثَمَّرْتُ أَجْرَهُ حَتَّى كَثُرَتْ مِنْهُ الأَمْوَالُ فَارْتَعَجَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ فَخَرَجُوا مِنَ الْغَارِ يَمْشُونَ
en_text: Muhammad ibn Sahl al-Tamimi, 'Abdullah ibn 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Bahram, and Abu Bakr ibn Ishaq narrated to me; Ibn Sahl said: He narrated to us, and the other two said: Abu al-Yaman informed us: Shu'ayb informed us, from al-Zuhri: Salim ibn 'Abdullah informed me that 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying: "Three persons from among those who were before you set out until the approach of night drove them to a cave..." and he related the hadith with the meaning of the hadith of Nafi' from Ibn 'Umar, except that he said: One of the men said: "O Allah, I had elderly, aged parents, and I never used to give evening milk to family or wealth before them." And he said: "So she refused me until a year of hardship struck her, so she came to me and I gave her one hundred and twenty dinars." And he said: "So I invested his wage until wealth multiplied from it and spread out abundantly." And he said: "So they exited the cave walking."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2744 a, book 50, باب فِي الْحَضِّ عَلَى التَّوْبَةِ وَالْفَرَحِ بِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُثْمَانَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ، سُوَيْدٍ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَعُودُهُ وَهُوَ مَرِيضٌ فَحَدَّثَنَا بِحَدِيثَيْنِ حَدِيثًا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَحَدِيثًا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِ مِنْ رَجُلٍ فِي أَرْضٍ دَوِيَّةٍ مَهْلَكَةٍ مَعَهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ عَلَيْهَا طَعَامُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ فَنَامَ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَقَدْ ذَهَبَتْ فَطَلَبَهَا حَتَّى أَدْرَكَهُ الْعَطَشُ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَرْجِعُ إِلَى مَكَانِي الَّذِي كُنْتُ فِيهِ فَأَنَامُ حَتَّى أَمُوتَ ‏.‏ فَوَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ عَلَى سَاعِدِهِ لِيَمُوتَ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَعِنْدَهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ وَعَلَيْهَا زَادُهُ وَطَعَامُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ فَاللَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ الْعَبْدِ الْمُؤْمِنِ مِنْ هَذَا بِرَاحِلَتِهِ وَزَادِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim—and the wording is 'Uthman's—narrated to us; Ishaq said: Jarir informed us, and 'Uthman said: Jarir narrated to us, from al-A'mash, from 'Umarah ibn 'Umayr, from al-Harith ibn Suwayd, who said: I visited 'Abdullah to inquire about him while he was ill, so he narrated to us two hadiths: a hadith from himself and a hadith from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying: "Allah is surely more pleased with the repentance of His believing servant than a man in a perilous desert wasteland with whom was his riding camel bearing his food and drink; he slept and then awakened to find it had gone. He searched for it until thirst overtook him, then he said: 'I will return to my place where I was and sleep until I die.' So he placed his head upon his forearm to die, then he awakened and there was his riding camel beside him bearing his provisions, food, and drink. For Allah is more pleased with the repentance of the believing servant than this man with his riding camel and his provisions."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2744 b, book 50, باب فِي الْحَضِّ عَلَى التَّوْبَةِ وَالْفَرَحِ بِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ قُطْبَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ مِنْ رَجُلٍ بِدَاوِيَّةٍ مِنَ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us: Yahya ibn Adam narrated to us, from Qutbah ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz, from al-A'mash with this chain of transmission, and he said: "than a man in an open, desolate wasteland."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2744 c, book 50, باب فِي الْحَضِّ عَلَى التَّوْبَةِ وَالْفَرَحِ بِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ، بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَارِثَ بْنَ سُوَيْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدِيثَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالآخَرُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏
en_text: And Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to me: Abu Usamah narrated to us: Al-A'mash narrated to us: 'Umarah ibn 'Umayr narrated to us, saying: I heard al-Harith ibn Suwayd saying: 'Abdullah narrated to me two hadiths: one of them from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and the other from himself. He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Allah is surely more pleased with the repentance of His believing servant..." similar to the hadith of Jarir.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2745, book 50, باب فِي الْحَضِّ عَلَى التَّوْبَةِ وَالْفَرَحِ بِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يُونُسَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، قَالَ خَطَبَ النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ مِنْ رَجُلٍ حَمَلَ زَادَهُ وَمَزَادَهُ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ ثُمَّ سَارَ حَتَّى كَانَ بِفَلاَةٍ مِنَ الأَرْضِ فَأَدْرَكَتْهُ الْقَائِلَةُ فَنَزَلَ فَقَالَ تَحْتَ شَجَرَةٍ فَغَلَبَتْهُ عَيْنُهُ وَانْسَلَّ بَعِيرُهُ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ فَسَعَى شَرَفًا فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ سَعَى شَرَفًا ثَانِيًا فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ سَعَى شَرَفًا ثَالِثًا فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا فَأَقْبَلَ حَتَّى أَتَى مَكَانَهُ الَّذِي قَالَ فِيهِ فَبَيْنَمَا هُوَ قَاعِدٌ إِذْ جَاءَهُ بَعِيرُهُ يَمْشِي حَتَّى وَضَعَ خِطَامَهُ فِي يَدِهِ فَلَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ الْعَبْدِ مِنْ هَذَا حِينَ وَجَدَ بَعِيرَهُ عَلَى حَالِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سِمَاكٌ فَزَعَمَ الشَّعْبِيُّ أَنَّ النُّعْمَانَ رَفَعَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَمَّا أَنَا فَلَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh al-'Anbari narrated to us: My father narrated to us: Abu Yunus narrated to us, from Simak, who said: Al-Nu'man ibn Bashir delivered a sermon and said: "Allah is surely more pleased with the repentance of His servant than a man who loaded his provisions and water skin onto a camel, then journeyed until he reached a desolate land; then the midday heat overtook him, so he dismounted and took a midday nap under a tree. Sleep overcame him and his camel slipped away. He woke up and ran up an elevated hill, but saw nothing; then he ran up a second elevated hill, but saw nothing; then he ran up a third elevated hill, but saw nothing. So he returned until he reached the spot where he had taken his midday nap. While he was sitting, suddenly his camel came walking toward him until it placed its halter into his hand. Surely Allah is more pleased with the repentance of the servant than this man when he found his camel in its state." Simak said: Al-Sha'bi claimed that al-Nu'man attributed this hadith to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), but as for me, I did not hear it [attributed to him].

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2746, book 50, باب فِي الْحَضِّ عَلَى التَّوْبَةِ وَالْفَرَحِ بِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ جَعْفَرٌ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِيَادِ بْنِ لَقِيطٍ، عَنْ إِيَادٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَيْفَ تَقُولُونَ بِفَرَحِ رَجُلٍ انْفَلَتَتْ مِنْهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ تَجُرُّ زِمَامَهَا بِأَرْضٍ قَفْرٍ لَيْسَ بِهَا طَعَامٌ وَلاَ شَرَابٌ وَعَلَيْهَا لَهُ طَعَامٌ وَشَرَابٌ فَطَلَبَهَا حَتَّى شَقَّ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ مَرَّتْ بِجِذْلِ شَجَرَةٍ فَتَعَلَّقَ زِمَامُهَا فَوَجَدَهَا مُتَعَلِّقَةً بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا شَدِيدًا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ مِنَ الرَّجُلِ بِرَاحِلَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ جَعْفَرٌ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِيَادٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya and Ja'far ibn Humayd narrated to us; Ja'far said: He narrated to us, and Yahya said: 'Ubaydullah ibn Iyad ibn Laqit informed us, from Iyad, from al-Bara' ibn 'Azib, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "What do you say about the joy of a man whose riding camel escaped from him, dragging its halter in a barren land in which there is neither food nor drink, while bearing for him his food and drink; so he searched for it until it became exhausting for him, then it passed by the stump of a tree and its halter got caught, so he found it entangled by it?" We said: "Very great joy, O Messenger of Allah." The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, by Allah, Allah is surely more pleased with the repentance of His servant than the man with his riding camel." Ja'far said: 'Ubaydullah ibn Iyad narrated to us from his father.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2747 a, book 50, باب فِي الْحَضِّ عَلَى التَّوْبَةِ وَالْفَرَحِ بِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، - وَهُوَ عَمُّهُ - قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ حِينَ يَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ كَانَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ بِأَرْضِ فَلاَةٍ فَانْفَلَتَتْ مِنْهُ وَعَلَيْهَا طَعَامُهُ وَشَرَابُهُ فَأَيِسَ مِنْهَا فَأَتَى شَجَرَةً فَاضْطَجَعَ فِي ظِلِّهَا قَدْ أَيِسَ مِنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ فَبَيْنَا هُوَ كَذَلِكَ إِذَا هُوَ بِهَا قَائِمَةً عِنْدَهُ فَأَخَذَ بِخِطَامِهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْفَرَحِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَبْدِي وَأَنَا رَبُّكَ ‏.‏ أَخْطَأَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْفَرَحِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Sabbah and Zuhayr ibn Harb both narrated to us: 'Umar ibn Yunus narrated to us: 'Ikrimah ibn 'Ammar narrated to us: Ishaq ibn 'Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah narrated to us: Anas ibn Malik—and he was his uncle—narrated to us, saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Allah is surely more pleased with the repentance of His servant when he repents to Him than one of you who was on his riding camel in a desert land and it escaped from him carrying his food and drink, so he despaired of it. He came to a tree and lay down in its shade, having despaired of his riding camel. While he was in that state, lo, it was standing right before him! So he took hold of its nose-rope and then said out of extreme joy: 'O Allah, You are my servant and I am your Lord!' He erred out of extreme joy."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2747 b, c, book 50, باب فِي الْحَضِّ عَلَى التَّوْبَةِ وَالْفَرَحِ بِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ عَلَى بَعِيرِهِ قَدْ أَضَلَّهُ بِأَرْضِ فَلاَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَحْمَدُ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ، مَالِكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Haddab ibn Khalid narrated to us: Hammam narrated to us: Qatadah narrated to us, from Anas ibn Malik, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Allah is surely more pleased with the repentance of His servant than one of you when he awakens finding his camel which he had lost in a desolate land." And Ahmad al-Darimi narrated it to me: Habban narrated to us: Hammam narrated to us: Qatadah narrated to us: Anas ibn Malik narrated to us, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2748 a, book 50, باب سُقُوطِ الذُّنُوبِ بِالاِسْتِغْفَارِ تَوْبَةً ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، - قَاصِّ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ - عَنْ أَبِي صِرْمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ حِينَ حَضَرَتْهُ الْوَفَاةُ كُنْتُ كَتَمْتُ عَنْكُمْ شَيْئًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لَوْلاَ أَنَّكُمْ تُذْنِبُونَ لَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ خَلْقًا يُذْنِبُونَ يَغْفِرُ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Layth narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Qays—the storyteller of 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz—from Abu Sirmah, from Abu Ayyub, that he said when death approached him: I had concealed from you something that I heard from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace); I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying: "Were it not that you commit sins, Allah would create a creation who commit sins and He forgives them."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2748 b, book 50, باب سُقُوطِ الذُّنُوبِ بِالاِسْتِغْفَارِ تَوْبَةً ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عِيَاضٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْفِهْرِيُّ - حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي صِرْمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبٌ يَغْفِرُهَا اللَّهُ لَكُمْ لَجَاءَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ لَهُمْ ذُنُوبٌ يَغْفِرُهَا لَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to us: Ibn Wahb narrated to us: 'Iyad—and he is Ibn 'Abdullah al-Fihri—narrated to me: Ibrahim ibn 'Ubayd ibn Rifa'ah narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Ka'b al-Qurazi, from Abu Sirmah, from Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), that he said: "Were it not that you had sins that Allah forgives for you, Allah would bring a people who have sins that He forgives for them."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2749, book 50, باب سُقُوطِ الذُّنُوبِ بِالاِسْتِغْفَارِ تَوْبَةً ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ الْجَزَرِيِّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَوْ لَمْ تُذْنِبُوا لَذَهَبَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ وَلَجَاءَ بِقَوْمٍ يُذْنِبُونَ فَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ فَيَغْفِرُ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Rafi' narrated to me: 'Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us: Ma'mar informed us, from Ja'far al-Jazari, from Yazid ibn al-Asamm, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "By Him in Whose Hand is my soul, if you did not commit sins, Allah would do away with you and bring a people who commit sins, so that they seek forgiveness from Allah and He forgives them."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2750 a, book 50, بَاب فَضْلِ دَوَامِ الذِّكْرِ وَالْفِكْرِ فِي أُمُورِ الْآخِرَةِ وَالْمُرَاقَبَةِ وَجَوَازِ تَرْكِ ذَلِكَ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَوْقَاتِ وَالِاشْتِغَالِ بِالدُّنْيَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَقَطَنُ بْنُ نُسَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ، بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ إِيَاسٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ الأُسَيِّدِيِّ، قَالَ - وَكَانَ مِنْ كُتَّابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ - لَقِيَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ كَيْفَ أَنْتَ يَا حَنْظَلَةُ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَافَقَ حَنْظَلَةُ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مَا تَقُولُ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَكُونُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُذَكِّرُنَا بِالنَّارِ وَالْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى كَأَنَّا رَأْىَ عَيْنٍ فَإِذَا خَرَجْنَا مِنْ عِنْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَافَسْنَا الأَزْوَاجَ وَالأَوْلاَدَ وَالضَّيْعَاتِ فَنَسِينَا كَثِيرًا قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنَّا لَنَلْقَى مِثْلَ هَذَا ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ حَتَّى دَخَلْنَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ نَافَقَ حَنْظَلَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَكُونُ عِنْدَكَ تُذَكِّرُنَا بِالنَّارِ وَالْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى كَأَنَّا رَأْىَ عَيْنٍ فَإِذَا خَرَجْنَا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ عَافَسْنَا الأَزْوَاجَ وَالأَوْلاَدَ وَالضَّيْعَاتِ نَسِينَا كَثِيرًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنْ لَوْ تَدُومُونَ عَلَى مَا تَكُونُونَ عِنْدِي وَفِي الذِّكْرِ لَصَافَحَتْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ عَلَى فُرُشِكُمْ وَفِي طُرُقِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَا حَنْظَلَةُ سَاعَةً وَسَاعَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi and Qatan ibn Nusayr—and the wording is Yahya's—narrated to us; Ja'far ibn Sulayman informed us, from Sa'id ibn Iyas al-Jurayri, from Abu 'Uthman al-Nahdi, from Hanzalah al-Usayyidi—he said: and he was one of the scribes of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)—who said: Abu Bakr met me and said: "How are you, O Hanzalah?" He said: I said: "Hanzalah has become a hypocrite." He said: "Subhan Allah! What are you saying?" He said: I said: "We are in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace); he reminds us of the Fire and Paradise until it is as though we see them with our own eyes. But when we leave the presence of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), we busy ourselves with our wives, children, and properties, and we forget much." Abu Bakr said: "By Allah, we also experience the like of this." So I and Abu Bakr set off until we entered upon the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). I said: "Hanzalah has become a hypocrite, O Messenger of Allah!" The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "And what is that?" I said: "O Messenger of Allah, we are in your presence and you remind us of the Fire and Paradise until it is as though we see them with our own eyes. But when we leave your presence, we busy ourselves with our wives, children, and properties, and we forget much." The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "By Him in Whose Hand is my soul, if you were to remain constantly in the state you are in while with me and in remembrance, the angels would shake hands with you on your beds and in your paths; but, O Hanzalah, an hour and an hour"—three times.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2750 b, book 50, بَاب فَضْلِ دَوَامِ الذِّكْرِ وَالْفِكْرِ فِي أُمُورِ الْآخِرَةِ وَالْمُرَاقَبَةِ وَجَوَازِ تَرْكِ ذَلِكَ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَوْقَاتِ وَالِاشْتِغَالِ بِالدُّنْيَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، الْجُرَيْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَعَظَنَا فَذَكَّرَ النَّارَ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ جِئْتُ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ فَضَاحَكْتُ الصِّبْيَانَ وَلاَعَبْتُ الْمَرْأَةَ - قَالَ - فَخَرَجْتُ فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ وَأَنَا قَدْ فَعَلْتُ مِثْلَ مَا تَذْكُرُ ‏.‏ فَلَقِينَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَافَقَ حَنْظَلَةُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَهْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَحَدَّثْتُهُ بِالْحَدِيثِ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَأَنَا قَدْ فَعَلْتُ مِثْلَ مَا فَعَلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا حَنْظَلَةُ سَاعَةً وَسَاعَةً وَلَوْ كَانَتْ تَكُونُ قُلُوبُكُمْ كَمَا تَكُونُ عِنْدَ الذِّكْرِ لَصَافَحَتْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ حَتَّى تُسَلِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الطُّرُقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to me: 'Abd al-Samad informed us: I heard my father narrating: Sa'id al-Jurayri narrated to us, from Abu 'Uthman al-Nahdi, from Hanzalah, who said: We were with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and he admonished us and reminded [us of] the Fire. He said: Then I came to the house, laughed with the children, and played with the woman (my wife). He said: Then I went out and met Abu Bakr, and I mentioned that to him. He said: "And I have done the like of what you mention." So we met the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and I said: "O Messenger of Allah, Hanzalah has become a hypocrite!" He said: "Hold on!" So I narrated the account to him. Then Abu Bakr said: "And I have done the like of what he did." He said: "O Hanzalah, an hour and an hour; and if your hearts remained as they are during the remembrance, the angels would shake hands with you until they greet you with peace in the streets."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2750 c, book 50, بَاب فَضْلِ دَوَامِ الذِّكْرِ وَالْفِكْرِ فِي أُمُورِ الْآخِرَةِ وَالْمُرَاقَبَةِ وَجَوَازِ تَرْكِ ذَلِكَ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَوْقَاتِ وَالِاشْتِغَالِ بِالدُّنْيَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ حَنْظَلَةَ التَّمِيمِيِّ الأُسَيِّدِيِّ الْكَاتِبِ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَّرَنَا الْجَنَّةَ وَالنَّارَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Al-Fadl ibn Dukayn narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Sa'id al-Jurayri, from Abu 'Uthman al-Nahdi, from Hanzalah al-Tamimi al-Usayyidi, the scribe, who said: We were with the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and he reminded us of Paradise and the Fire... and he mentioned similar to their hadith.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2751 a, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَمَّا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ كَتَبَ فِي كِتَابِهِ فَهُوَ عِنْدَهُ فَوْقَ الْعَرْشِ إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي تَغْلِبُ غَضَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Al-Mughirah—meaning al-Hizami—narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "When Allah created the creation, He wrote in His Book, which is with Him above the Throne: 'Indeed, My mercy prevails over My wrath.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2751 b, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ سَبَقَتْ رَحْمَتِي غَضَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace): "Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said: 'My mercy has preceded My wrath.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2751 c, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو ضَمْرَةَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ، بْنِ مِينَاءَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَمَّا قَضَى اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ كَتَبَ فِي كِتَابِهِ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ فَهُوَ مَوْضُوعٌ عِنْدَهُ إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي تَغْلِبُ غَضَبِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ali ibn Khashram narrated to us: Abu Damrah informed us, from al-Harith ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, from 'Ata' ibn Mina', from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "When Allah decreed the creation, He wrote in His Book upon Himself, and it is placed with Him: 'Indeed, My mercy prevails over My wrath.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2752 a, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الرَّحْمَةَ مِائَةَ جُزْءٍ فَأَمْسَكَ عِنْدَهُ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ وَأَنْزَلَ فِي الأَرْضِ جُزْءًا وَاحِدًا فَمِنْ ذَلِكَ الْجُزْءِ تَتَرَاحَمُ الْخَلاَئِقُ حَتَّى تَرْفَعَ الدَّابَّةُ حَافِرَهَا عَنْ وَلَدِهَا خَشْيَةَ أَنْ تُصِيبَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Harmalah ibn Yahya al-Tujibi narrated to us: Ibn Wahb informed us: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab informed him that Abu Hurayrah said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) saying: "Allah made mercy into one hundred parts. He kept ninety-nine parts with Himself and sent down one single part to the earth. From that single part, all creatures show mercy to one another, until a mare lifts its hoof from its foal out of fear that it might harm it."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2752 b, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ فَوَضَعَ وَاحِدَةً بَيْنَ خَلْقِهِ وَخَبَأَ عِنْدَهُ مِائَةً إِلاَّ وَاحِدَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Ayyub, Qutaybah, and Ibn Hujr said: Isma'il—meaning Ibn Ja'far—narrated to us, from al-'Ala', from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Allah created one hundred mercies; He placed one among His creation and concealed with Himself one hundred less one."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2752 c, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ أَنْزَلَ مِنْهَا رَحْمَةً وَاحِدَةً بَيْنَ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ وَالْبَهَائِمِ وَالْهَوَامِّ فَبِهَا يَتَعَاطَفُونَ وَبِهَا يَتَرَاحَمُونَ وَبِهَا تَعْطِفُ الْوَحْشُ عَلَى وَلَدِهَا وَأَخَّرَ اللَّهُ تِسْعًا وَتِسْعِينَ رَحْمَةً يَرْحَمُ بِهَا عِبَادَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us: My father narrated to us: 'Abd al-Malik narrated to us, from 'Ata', from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), who said: "Indeed, Allah has one hundred mercies. He sent down one mercy thereof among the jinn, humans, beasts, and vermin, by which they show affection, by which they show mercy to one another, and by which the wild beast shows compassion to its child; and Allah has reserved ninety-nine mercies with which He will show mercy to His servants on the Day of Resurrection."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2753 a, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيُّ عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مِائَةَ رَحْمَةٍ فَمِنْهَا رَحْمَةٌ بِهَا يَتَرَاحَمُ الْخَلْقُ بَيْنَهُمْ وَتِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Hakam ibn Musa narrated to me: Mu'adh ibn Mu'adh narrated to us: Sulayman al-Taymi narrated to us: Abu 'Uthman al-Nahdi narrated to us, from Salman al-Farsi, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, Allah has one hundred mercies; among them is one mercy by which creation shows mercy among themselves, and ninety-nine are for the Day of Resurrection."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2753 b, book 50, باب فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنَّهَا سَبَقَتْ غَضَبَهُ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
en_text: And Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-A'la narrated it to us: Al-Mu'tamir narrated to us, from his father, with this chain of transmission.
